# KyuzenOS — LLVM libc baremetal x86_64 public headers (Phase 0)
#
# Only headers whose entrypoints are enabled in entrypoints.txt are listed.
#
# NOT listed because LLVM libc 22.1.8 does not provide them as libc targets
# (they are freestanding headers supplied by clang itself):
#   stddef.h, stdbool.h, stdalign.h, stdatomic.h
#
# NOT listed because their modules are out of scope:
#   fenv.h, setjmp.h, assert.h,
#   complex.h, math.h, wchar.h, wctype.h, uchar.h, stdfix.h
# Phase 4: time.h AKTIF (§16 audit). Catatan: time.h hasil hdrgen mendeklarasikan
# SEMUA fungsi time upstream (termasuk time/difftime/nanosleep); yang menentukan
# keterpautan adalah entrypoints.txt — simbol tanpa entrypoint = link error yang
# jujur, bukan stub palsu.

set(TARGET_PUBLIC_HEADERS
    libc.include.ctype
    libc.include.errno
    libc.include.inttypes
    libc.include.locale
    libc.include.stdbit
    libc.include.stdint
    libc.include.stdio
    libc.include.stdlib
    libc.include.string
    libc.include.strings
    libc.include.time
)
